text:
mike_p: AcmeEdge pinged asking to go-live next week. They currently push hourly CSV drops to partner S3. Wed prefer signed webhooks. Can we run a controlled CSV pilot instead? Need agreement on: manifest schema, timestamp semantics (UTC epoch), signature verification, idempotency, timezone/DST, SKU->billing mapping, and a minimal smoke-test checklist.

sara_pm: Pilot ok if shadow (no billing) for 10 business days and with signed manifest listing files + HMAC. Require partner to provide negative tests (duplicates, missing cols, late arrivals). Will provide acceptance criteria.

raj_eng: Engineering: require deterministic filenames (YYYYMMDD-HH-partner.csv) + manifest.json with file list + X-Manifest-Signature (HMAC-SHA256). Row schema: partner_id, sku_id, usage_epoch_utc, quantity, unit, row_id. If row_id not present compute sha256(row) as row_id. Use epoch seconds in UTC only. Example CSV row: ACME123,EDGE-XL,1717766400,60,device-minutes,row-0001

Signature verify example: openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$PARTNER_SECRET" manifest.json | base64

If manifest missing/invalid fail ingestion and alert ops. Also include clear error codes for parse errors vs duplicates.

jess_ops: Billing: define partner_sku_mapping table (sku_id -> billing_dimension(seats|device_minutes|requests) and required_fields). If required field missing (e.g., seat_count for seat SKU) mark row NEED_RECON and exclude from auto-invoice. Nightly recon job moves NEED_RECON to ops queue; add charge-hold toggle while pilot active. Define proration: device-minutes rounded up to minute, seats prorated by UTC day.

anna_legal: Legal: SOW must state retention: raw CSV+manifests retained 12 months, audit logs 3 years. Prohibit plaintext PII; if needed must be pseudonymized. Add audit rights + indemnity clause for corrupted usage causing misbilling.

mike_p: Owners: raj_eng -> ingestion spec + 3 example sets (clean, dupes, corrupt) by EOD today (+6h). sara_pm -> acceptance checklist & smoke-tests by tomorrow. jess_ops -> sku mapping doc + nightly recon design by day after tomorrow. anna_legal -> SOW redline by EOW.

sara_pm: Ill include tests: duplicate rows, late-arrival (48h tolerance), out-of-order timestamps, DST cutover cases, empty files. Also a CSV->webhook converter script for partner validation.

raj_eng: Will include monitoring signals: partner.ingest.latency, partner.parse.errors/hr, partner.duplicate.rows/hr, partner.missing.manifest. Add alert when parse_errors spike > 5/hr.

jess_ops: Ill add nightly job that moves UNKNOWN/STALLED rows to ops-staging and sends Slack alert with sample rows. Also create manual reconciliation playbook and user story for billing UI team to surface NEED_RECON counts.

deploy-bot: scheduled: partner-ingest-shadow -> tomorrow 08:00 PST (staging).

mike_p: Can everyone meet these deadlines? I'll schedule 30m signoff Thurs 10am to decide go/no-go and message AcmeEdge.

sara_pm: Confirmed.

raj_eng: Confirmed.

jess_ops: Confirmed.

anna_legal: Confirmed, will upload redline.

mike_p: Thanks  I'll DM AcmeEdge to delay go-live until pilot signoff complete.
